text: Transportation Services is recommending designation of an on-street accessible loading zone on Concord Avenue. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access to TTC Wheel-Trans service for a local resident. There should be no issues here because there is no loss of parking. Therefore I am requesting that Toronto and East York Community council designate this loading zone.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily, on the east side of Concord Avenue, between a point 27.5 metres south of Northumberland Street and a point 5.5 metres further south.
